To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the surface resistance of untwinned Y-123 films has been measured at 10 GHz.
we have fabricated and characterized partially untwinned films of YBCO on NdGaO/sub3/ substrates by sputtering.
we have fabricated and characterized YBCO thin films that are nearly untwinned, and that have anisotropic surface resistance near 10 GHz.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of microwave resonators for the measurement of the properties of superconductors.
the microwave properties of YBCO films with a high degree of c-axis orientation.
the development of high T/sub c/ superconducting microwave devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the surface resistance of partially untwinned films is comparable with that of untwinned Y-123 crystals.
the microwave surface resistance of partially untwinned films is comparable to that of the best untwinned Y-123 films.
the microwave properties are similar to the properties of single crystals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the fabrication and characterization of partially untwinned films.
we have successfully fabricated partially untwinned films on twin-free substrates.
the partially untwinned films are a good model system for the study of the microwave properties of YBCO.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the surface resistances in both directions of partially untwinned films are lower than those in untwinned single crystals.
the microwave resonances of partially untwinned films can be used to determine the anisotropy of the surface resistance and the ratio of the a and b DC resistances.
it is possible to fabricate high-Q microwave resonators with YBCO films that are not completely untwinned.
